definitions.gloss: to master; to use skillfully; to handle proficiently
definitions.explanation: To have thorough knowledge and skill in using something, getting the most out of it.

examples.japanese: このソフトを{使|つか}いこなすには{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: It takes time to master this software.

examples.japanese: {道具|どうぐ}を{使|つか}いこなせるようになりたい。
examples.english: I want to become able to handle tools skillfully.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{外国語|がいこくご}を{使|つか}いこなしている。
スマホの{機能|きのう}を{全|すべ}て{使|つか}いこなせる{人|ひと}は{少|すく}ない。
examples.english: Few people can use all the features of a smartphone to their full potential.

examples.japanese: {何年|なんねん}も{練習|れんしゅう}して、ようやくこの{楽器|がっき}を{使|つか}いこなせるようになった。
examples.english: After years of practice, I finally became able to handle this instrument proficiently.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
Pattern: [tool/skill]を{使|つか}いこなす

ASPECT (ている):
{使|つか}いこなしている indicates a state of having mastered something.

- {使|つか}いこなさない (negative)
- {使|つか}いこなして (te-form)
- {使|つか}いこなした (past)
- {使|つか}いこなせる (potential) - commonly used

FORMS:
{使|つか}う (to use) + こなす (to handle completely)

The auxiliary verb こなす indicates doing something thoroughly or skillfully.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- パソコンを{使|つか}いこなす - to be proficient with computers
- {言語|げんご}を{使|つか}いこなす - to master a language
- {機能|きのう}を{使|つか}いこなす - to make full use of features
- {完全|かんぜん}に{使|つか}いこなす - to fully master

SIMILAR WORDS:
- マスターする - to master (loanword)
- {習熟|しゅうじゅく}する - to become proficient
- {熟知|じゅくち}する - to know thoroughly
